    m.addConstr(-0.64 * vars['Var_0'] + -3.91 * vars['Var_2'] + -1.98 * vars['Var_3'] + -2.01 * vars['Var_4'] + 2.88 * vars['Var_5'] <= -27.83, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(7.91 * vars['Var_1'] + 6.41 * vars['Var_2'] + -0.2 * vars['Var_4'] + -1.9 * vars['Var_5'] <= 62.23, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(-4.8 * vars['Var_0'] + -8.0 * vars['Var_2'] + -0.84 * vars['Var_3'] + -4.36 * vars['Var_4'] + 2.74 * vars['Var_5'] <= -82.79, name='C7')
